_about: Quickstream, the sea current (levels 7-11): the stray sharks are elites.

791415.name: pike river snapping fish
791415.long_desc: A snapping river pike lurks in the reeds, all teeth and green scales.
791415.description: It is as long as a man's leg, mottled green and brown, with a jaw full of needle teeth. It strikes at anything that moves in the water.
791415.why: the zone's regulars (tools/audit/densify.py fills its empty rooms with them): it had no ordinary foe of its own
